evidence: Cic. Div. 2.56: quia gallī victī silēre solērent, canere victōrēs

terms.comment: Found only in the late Carmen dē Philomēlā.

phrases.latin: gallō canente spēs redit, aegrīs salūs refunditur
phrases.english: when the cock crows, hope returns, and health flows back to the sick

sources: Lewis & Short: cano
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 144, 299.
Ambrose’s hymn from the Latinitas loci collection (loci-augustinus).
